preconditions.description: The length of the input string S is between 1 and 5, inclusive.
All characters in the input string S are alphabetic.

postconditions.expression: all(permutation in output for permutation in set(itertools.permutations(S)))
postconditions.description: Each permutation in the output is a unique permutation of the input string S.
The output is sorted in lexicographically ascending order.
The number of permutations in the output is equal to the factorial of the length of the input string S.
